_about: MISSING PIECES (Dom, Oct 23 2026): the one or two pieces that would push each Dark Knight team over the top. Not a filter - the Scout still shows everything it finds; a find at one of these positions gets tagged 'fills a missing piece'. Short on purpose; reviewed each week. pos = the Yahoo positions that would fill it. test (Oct 25) = how the build checks it every run against the live roster and Yahoo's weekly projections: at least `need` rostered men at `pos` projecting `min`+ points, every week from `from` (or this week) through Week 17. The check only reports - it never changes this file; Dom confirms a change first.
